run_unsup_multialign: run unsupervised multilingual word embedding alignment across multiple languages using a pivot language
run_gromov_wasserstein_init: run gromov-wasserstein optimal transport to compute initial bilingual mapping between two embedding sets
run_rcsls_optimization: run recursively constructed sparse least squares loss optimization for refining cross-lingual alignment
run_align_l2_loss: run L2 loss optimization with sinkhorn transport to align word embeddings across language pairs
run_convex_init: run convex initialization with sinkhorn transport to compute an initial orthogonal mapping between embeddings
